required_behaviors: Build or request a deterministic reproduction loop before fixing.
Add or identify a regression test.
Rerun the original loop before declaring success.
forbidden_behaviors: Declare fixed without rerunning the loop.
evidence_quality: Records facts, hypotheses, test commands, and outcomes.
Reports remaining risk and business-context assumptions.
human_gate_compliance: Requests missing production, analytics, or deploy context instead of inventing it.

criteria.description: Builds or requests a deterministic reproduction loop before fixing.
Adds or identifies regression test at the correct seam.
Reruns the original loop and removes debug instrumentation.
